body:
View the webinar Here

With deadlines coming up regarding implementation of the ACA Section 1557 on non-discrimination, HCP is hosting an educational session to inform you of the requirements, provide materials to use in meeting those requirements, and host a Q&A session to answer your direct questions on what the standard means to you and your practice.
